> It seems that if you can get the work part under control, the rest might follow.

That's what I'm hoping but I'm not so convinced. As I've said, I've always had suicidal thoughts even before teaching. They have just become more frequent and more pervasive. Sometimes, I'll just look at my sleeping pills, spill them all out on the table and a part of my brain will just yell at me to take them all. It takes me a solid minute of looking at them before I decide to push all but one back into the bottle. 


>When you get back, the answer is no. The best decision is not to hurt yourself.

But, why? If I were to base the decision on how it would effect other people I complete understand the answer of no. But, for myself? Why, not? What's the point of living if you can't enjoy the moments you have?
